notes: Every technical field is anchored to a primary source id in hybrid_llm_primary_source_registry.json. 'evidence_scale' records the strongest published training scale for the mechanism as reported by its primary source; it is not an endorsement. Fields marked 'reported' come from the source's own claims (not independently reproduced in this audit).

architectures.name: DeltaNet
architectures.state_update: S_t = S_{t-1}(I - beta_t k_t k_t^T) + beta_t k_t v_t^T  (delta rule; corrects the key's stored value)
architectures.erase_control: implicit via delta correction on the addressed key only
architectures.state_shape: matrix S in R^{d_k x d_v} per head (bounded, seq-independent)
architectures.train_algorithm: chunkwise parallel over sequence via Householder-product (WY) representation
architectures.complexity: train O(N) chunked; decode O(1)/token; state O(d_k*d_v)
architectures.evidence_scale: up to ~1.3B in follow-ups; standard LM settings

architectures.name: Gated DeltaNet (GDN)
architectures.state_update: S_t = alpha_t * S_{t-1}(I - beta_t k_t k_t^T) + beta_t k_t v_t^T  (scalar gated decay alpha_t adds adaptive forgetting)
architectures.erase_control: delta correction; tied to write via scalar
architectures.state_shape: matrix S in R^{d_k x d_v} per head (bounded)
architectures.train_algorithm: chunkwise parallel (extends DeltaNet WY with gating)
architectures.complexity: train O(N); decode O(1)/token; state O(d_k*d_v)
architectures.license: MIT kernels; Apache weights via Qwen3-Next
architectures.role: PRODUCTION-PROVEN recurrent core; the conservative modern default

architectures.name: Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) / Kimi Linear
architectures.mixer_type: fine-grained (channel-wise) gated delta-rule linear attention + MLA hybrid
architectures.state_update: gated delta rule with channel-wise gating via a Diagonal-Plus-Low-Rank (DPLR) transition; refines GDN's scalar gate into per-channel control
architectures.erase_control: delta correction; still coupled to write
architectures.state_shape: matrix state per head (bounded); DPLR-structured transition
architectures.full_attention_ratio: 3:1 KDA:MLA (layerwise hybrid; MLA = Multi-head Latent Attention as the periodic global layer)
architectures.train_algorithm: bespoke chunkwise algorithm specialized for DPLR transitions
architectures.decode: true O(1) recurrent state for KDA layers; MLA layers use compressed-latent KV
architectures.complexity: train O(N); decode near-O(1) dominated by sparse MLA layers; up to 75% KV-cache reduction; up to 6x decode throughput at 1M ctx (reported)
architectures.materializes_NxN: only in the 1-in-4 MLA global layers (by design); KDA layers do not
architectures.open_checkpoint: YES: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B Base + Instruct (48B total / 3B active MoE, ~5.7T tokens)
architectures.evidence_scale: 48B-A3B MoE, ~5.7T tokens; matches/surpasses full attention short+long+RL (reported)
architectures.retrieval: strong; hybrid design retains exact global path via MLA
architectures.role: STRONGEST FULLY-OPEN production KDA-MLA hybrid; leading 'greatest' candidate

architectures.name: Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2)
architectures.mixer_type: erase/write-decoupled channel-wise gated delta-rule linear attention
architectures.state_update: Gated Delta Rule-2: channel-wise ERASE gate b_t (key-side removal) and channel-wise WRITE gate w_t (value-side insertion) + KDA-inherited channel-wise decay; reduces to KDA when b_t=w_t scalar, to GDN when decay also scalar
architectures.erase_control: DECOUPLED channel-wise erase gate b_t (the key novelty; ablations show it drives most of the gain)
architectures.state_shape: matrix state per head (bounded); 16 heads d_k=d_v=128 at 1.3B
architectures.train_algorithm: chunkwise WY with channel-wise decay absorbed into asymmetric erase factors; gate-aware backward pass
architectures.complexity: train O(N) (modest constant overhead vs GDN/KDA); decode O(1)/token; state bounded
architectures.kernels: official NVlabs code; added to flash-linear-attention (May 2026)
architectures.runtime_support: FLA; not yet in a shipped production LLM at audit date
architectures.license: NVIDIA Source Code License-NC (NON-COMMERCIAL) -- packaging blocker
architectures.retrieval: BEST among recurrent families on RULER MK-NIAH multi-key (reported): MK-NIAH-1@4K 37.8 recurrent / 48.0 hybrid; best Wiki 15.90 / LMB 11.41 ppl vs Mamba-2/GDN/KDA/Mamba-3
architectures.role: CHRONOLOGICALLY LATEST + strongest reported recurrent retrieval; but non-commercial license, no checkpoints, single 1.3B evidence point

architectures.name: Mamba-2
architectures.state_update: selective SSM: h_t = A_t h_{t-1} + B_t x_t; scalar/diagonal state transition
architectures.complexity: train O(N); decode O(1); state bounded
architectures.retrieval: weaker in-context recall than delta-rule family (motivated GDN)
architectures.role: mature SSM baseline; delta-rule family generally exceeds it on retrieval

architectures.name: Mamba-3
architectures.state_update: complex-valued state update + exponential-trapezoidal discretization + MIMO formulation
architectures.state_shape: complex state, ~2x smaller than Mamba-2 for equal ppl
architectures.decode: true O(1) recurrent; ~half decode cost of Mamba-2 (reported)
architectures.complexity: train O(N); decode O(1); state bounded (halved)
architectures.evidence_scale: reported matches Mamba-2 ppl at half state; GDN-2 paper reports Mamba-3 MIMO 16.45/11.66 at 1.3B (below GDN-2)
architectures.retrieval: improved state-tracking; below GDN-2 on the GDN-2 paper's retrieval table (reported)
architectures.role: SSM frontier alternative; complex-state, not delta-rule

architectures.name: Qwen3-Next (production GDN hybrid)
architectures.mixer_type: Gated DeltaNet + gated full attention hybrid
architectures.state_update: GDN in linear layers; softmax in periodic full-attention layers
architectures.state_shape: GDN matrix state + full-attention KV in 1/4 layers
architectures.decode: O(1) for GDN layers; KV cache for full layers (hybrid KV manager)
architectures.complexity: sub-quadratic overall; retains partial quadratic from full layers
architectures.materializes_NxN: only in the 1/4 full-attention layers (by design)
architectures.evidence_scale: large production MoE, open weights, deployed at scale
architectures.retrieval: strong (full layers preserve exact global retrieval)
architectures.role: REFERENCE production 3:1 GDN:full topology; proves the pattern at scale

architectures.name: MiniMax-M1 (Lightning Attention hybrid)
architectures.state_shape: bounded linear-attention state + periodic full KV

architectures.name: MiniMax-M2 (full-attention reversion)
architectures.mixer_type: full multi-head attention (ALL layers) -- reverted from hybrid
architectures.role: COUNTER-EVIDENCE: a major lab abandoned its linear-attention hybrid for full attention in production, reporting no efficient-attention variant reliably matched full-attention quality across reasoning/coding/agent tasks

architectures.name: Nemotron-H
architectures.full_attention_ratio: ~8% attention / ~92% Mamba-2 (e.g. 4 attn of 52 layers at 8B)
architectures.complexity: sub-quadratic; up to 3x throughput vs Transformers (reported)

architectures.name: Jamba
architectures.role: early production Transformer-Mamba hybrid; topology reference

architectures.name: Full attention (SWA/GQA/MLA) baseline
architectures.mixer_type: softmax attention with efficiency variants (sliding-window, grouped-query, multi-head latent)
architectures.complexity: quadratic prefill (windowed => linear within window); linear KV growth (MLA compresses)
architectures.role: conservative fallback (Candidate G); MLA/GQA/SWA are the periodic global layer for every hybrid above
